Global context

Available since version 8.0.

AccountingRegisters

Events:

Description:

The global context is initialized when you open a configuration in 1C:Enterprise mode and is available until the configuration is closed. All global context properties, procedures, and functions are available in any configuration module.

Available since:

Available since version 8.0.
